name: Suzhou Hengmingda Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Hengmingda Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sales of precision flexible structural components and precision metal structural components in China and internationally. It offers paste and fix, shielding, insulating, buffer, heat dissipation, dustproof, and protection functional devices. The company also provides consumer electronic protection products, precision structural parts, precision sheet metal products, EMS assemblies, automation equipment, and internet of things equipment.
